definitions.gloss: shigureni; food simmered in soy sauce, sugar, and ginger
definitions.explanation: A preserved side dish of thinly sliced beef or shellfish cooked down in soy sauce, sugar, and plenty of ginger until glossy and strongly flavoured. Eaten in small amounts with rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時雨|しぐれ}{煮|に}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{時雨|しぐれ}{煮|に}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせて⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I eat it with shigureni on top of the rice.

examples.japanese: {三重県|みえけん}{桑名|くわな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦はまぐり→ハマグリ：23183_hamaguri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時雨|しぐれ}{煮|に}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The clam shigureni from Kuwana in Mie Prefecture is famous as a souvenir.

notes:
The name comes from ⟦{時雨|しぐれ}→時雨：30753_shigure⟧, the brief late-autumn shower — said to refer either to the season the clams were best or to how quickly the dish is made.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牛|ぎゅう}{時雨|しぐれ}{煮|に}: beef shigureni
- ⟦はまぐり→ハマグリ：23183_hamaguri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時雨|しぐれ}{煮|に}: clam shigureni
- {時雨|しぐれ}{煮|に}⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧: shigureni-style flavouring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{佃煮|つくだに}→佃煮：04970_tsukudani⟧: food simmered in soy and sugar — the broader category; {時雨|しぐれ}{煮|に} is the version with ginger
- ⟦{甘辛|あまから}い→甘辛い：27507_amakarai⟧: sweet-and-salty — the flavour profile both share
